detailed_description:
CellChat v2配体-受体分析。和弦图/气泡图/信号角色热图。从Seurat输出链接

适用场景: 多细胞类型, disease, aging, development

分析步骤:
  - Create CellChat object: Import from Seurat
  - L-R interaction inference: CellChatDB v2 matching
  - Signal flow visualization: netVisual_aggregate
  - Comparison (multi-condition): compareInteractions
  - Source-target summary: Signal contribution

依赖包: reticulate, Seurat, CellChat, NMF, cellchat

难度: intermediate

触发提示: "分析细胞间通讯"

别名: 细胞通讯 (CellChat v2)
when_to_use: 适用于: 多细胞类型, disease, aging, development

proven_params.params: CellChat v2, Young vs Old separately, 10 cell types, secreted+cell-cell contact signaling
proven_params.result: Young: 9 interactions, 21 pathways. Old: 9 interactions, 24 pathways. 12 figures generated (chord+heatmap+bubble per group)

proven_params.params: min.pct=0.1, trim=0.1, type=truncatedMean, population.size=FALSE+TRUE compared, 7 subclusters, 39 pathways, LAMININ/COLLAGEN/TGFb/NRG/NCAM key
proven_params.result: CellChat v2完成: 11630 cells, 7 subclusters, 39通路。标志基因验证排除FAP污染。发现ECM重塑(COL1A1/LAMININ)、NMJ信号(NRG/NCAM)、TGFb纤维化、WNT/FGF肌源性。population.size归一化后zone1主导(去神经化)。14/15通路跨参数一致。19张图。

35 signaling pathways detected. Top: LAMININ(2.27), COLLAGEN(1.51), PTPRM(0.93), EGF(0.26), CD45(0.22), PARs(0.20), PECAM1(0.19), THBS(0.17), NOTCH(0.15), VEGF(0.09). 447 significant interactions. ECM

proven_params.params: CellChatDB.human; population.size=TRUE; Young=3771 cells, Old=6229 cells; 11 cell types; min.cells=10
proven_params.result: Young: 22 pathways, 208 interactions. Top: PTPRM, EGF, LAMININ. Old: 43 pathways, 416 interactions. Top: PTPRM, LAMININ, COLLAGEN. Aging doublings communication: 2X pathways & interactions. 2 heatmaps
